title: Claude Code PreToolUse allow skips the permission prompt; Antigravity allow does not
what: Claude adapter must return {} for Allow and updatedInput without permissionDecision for Overwrite; Antigravity requires decision allow, which defers to its default policy
why: Emitting permissionDecision allow auto-approved every tool call that no guard matched
